en.title: Circuits of Calm, Echoes of Steam
en.premise: In a city long accustomed to a fully automated existence, Ren, a young man who repairs broken drones, comes across a record chip of a "vanished village" that has been completely erased from the digital archives. The chip contains glimpses of a world before the rise of nanotechnology—landscapes where clumsy, heavy steam engines once churned. As he deciphers the data, Ren begins to encounter the "tangible pain" of humanity, something discarded in the relentless pursuit of efficiency. In a world far too convenient, he chooses to trace the memories of an inconvenient past.

zh.title: 宁静的回路，蒸汽的残响
zh.premise: 在一座早已习惯全自动化生活的都市中，修理小型无人机的青年——レン，偶然获得了一枚记录着“消失的村庄”的芯片，而这段记录在数字档案中已被彻底抹除。芯片中记录着纳米技术普及之前的景象：那是笨重而迟钝的“蒸汽机”运转的世界。在解读芯片的过程中，レン逐渐触碰到了那些在追求极致效率的过程中被技术舍弃的、人类“触手可及的痛苦”。在这个过于便利的世界里，他选择去追寻那段不便的过去记忆。
